svg.title: A7 unpopulated board, rear face
svg.desc: Illustrative black solder mask, gold exposed pads and white silkscreen. Exact native KiCad profile/silkscreen and CAD pad positions; no hidden masked tracks shown. This material-colour preview is not fabrication colour or plating control. Components are deliberately unpopulated.
